scope: Read-only review of exact R2 resource-repair script. No execution, tests, target-host/provider/DB/browser calls, or credential/config-value reads.

reviewed_safeguards.assert_optimization_bypass: RESOLVED: all critical checks use explicit require(condition, code) and remain active under optimized Python; no assert statements remain.
reviewed_safeguards.receipt_durability_before_mutation: RESOLVED: the expected root-owned, mode-restricted directory chain is lstat-validated; the receipt is created exclusively with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and mode 0600, initial FAILED record is flushed/fsynced, and the containing directory is fsynced before locks/config/cache changes.
reviewed_safeguards.mutation_progress: PASS: before each unlink the exact cache path is recorded as next_cache_to_remove and persisted; after unlink, removed list is updated and persisted. A crash leaves a precreated receipt that identifies whether removal was pending or completed.
reviewed_safeguards.apt_configuration: PASS: only a previously absent named apt.conf.d file is created with pkgcache and srcpkgcache set to empty values, then apt-config dump is checked for both effective settings before either cache unlink.
reviewed_safeguards.cache_scope: PASS: exactly two fixed /var/cache/apt binary cache paths are considered. Each is lstat-checked regular, root-owned, single-link and bounded in size; device/inode/size/mtime are rechecked immediately before unlink. APT lists and package archives are retained.
reviewed_safeguards.apt_and_dpkg_exclusion: PASS: nonblocking POSIX locks are acquired for APT lists/archive and dpkg frontend/backend lock paths; a process scan also rejects known apt/dpkg/unattended-upgrade executable names.
reviewed_safeguards.postconditions: PASS: dpkg status SHA must remain identical and post-removal free space/inodes must meet 3 GiB and 200,000 floors before receipt result becomes PASS.

remaining_limitations: The operation is deliberately one-shot: a pre-mutation lock contention or other failed attempt still produces the exclusive receipt, so a retry requires a separately reviewed process rather than silently rerunning over history.

Filesystem power-loss durability for the config/cache directory entries is not fully guaranteed because their containing directories are not fsynced after each create/unlink; the receipt itself is fsynced. This is not a blocker for the requested bounded live operation, but a crash-consistency enhancement could fsync those directory descriptors.
deployment_gate: No source blocker remains for the bounded repair when invoked by the reported isolated `/usr/bin/python3 -I` runner. Preserve R1 HOLD and R2 HOLD as historical receipts; this PASS applies only to the exact R2 SHA above. Post-run acceptance still requires the operator's receipt to show both intended cache removals, apt-config readback, unchanged dpkg status, and resource floors.
